decisions.reason: The piqué upholstery fabric still has its own website page and sits close to the core upholstery offer, so the visible commitment and the short time on the market favour persisting with it.
The bouclé-effect decorative fabric fits the established range, but its only light website presence means less public commitment, which makes it somewhat more exposed than the featured products.
The flame-retardant jacquard reflects development investment, serves strategically important contract and hospitality customers and has its own page, so management will strongly persist with it.
The wool bouclé leno embodies the announced shift toward renewable materials, so management can justify keeping it and attribute slow uptake to temporary market conditions.
The braided-structure fabric was launched only in 2024 with its own website page, so the fresh investment and visible commitment make a withdrawal very unlikely this early.
